campaigns.title: Lantern Garden
campaigns.blurb: A dusky garden of paper lanterns, flowers and fireflies. Light them all, at your own pace.

campaigns.title: Moonlit Lake
campaigns.blurb: A calm night lake where the moon shines twice. Collect moon pearls among ripples and reeds.

campaigns.title: Snowglobe Hollow
campaigns.blurb: Soft snow on a cosy village under the aurora. Snowflakes, pine trees and warm windows.

campaigns.title: Sugar Rush
campaigns.blurb: Lollipops, gumdrops and a giant donut. The gentlest climb, sweet from the first shot to the last.

campaigns.title: Carnival Skies
campaigns.blurb: Balloons, kites and a turning ferris wheel high above the midway. A brisker climb.

campaigns.title: Coral Groove
campaigns.blurb: Swim through pearl bubbles, coral castles and spinning tides in a bright living reef.

campaigns.title: Neon Highway
campaigns.blurb: Race a synthwave road into the sunset through spinning wheels, sliding traffic and spike strips.

campaigns.title: Starlight Warp
campaigns.blurb: Warp through hyperspace: ring tunnels, orbiting moons, warp gates and a black hole.

campaigns.title: Quasar Core
campaigns.blurb: Dive through rotating debris, gravity wells and armoured reactors to the heart of a quasar.

campaigns.title: Benny's Original
campaigns.blurb: The twenty levels from the first Benny’s P3GL, on the new board.
